records.intended_purpose: In-memory Algerian SCF double-entry accounting in integer DZD centimes
intended_features: Chart classes 1–7 with recognized account prefixes and DZD formatting
Entry validation with a nonblank supporting-document reference and equal debit and credit totals
Append-only posting by entry ID, monotonic period closure, reversal posting and date-windowed balances and trial balance
Dated TVA rate table, integer HT/TTC rounding and G50 TVA position from 4457 and 4456 account prefixes
Single-exercice compte de résultat par nature and bilan
records.audit_finding: Characterized at registered_at_sha. The README and source exclude persistence and replay, multi-exercice carry-forward and result allocation, IBS/IRG/payroll, cash-flow statements, annexes, tax filings beyond the G50 TVA position, and multicurrency. Entry validation checks the presence of a document reference only. The TVA table has two dated rows; their legal applicability needs independent review. scf_core_test.exs contains example assertions for validation, posting, closure, reversal, TVA and statements. The property suite samples bounded ledgers over a fixed account subset and asserts trial-balance equality, bilan equality, TCR net income, posting-order independence and reversal cancellation with standard attributes. Ledger.reverse/3 merges caller attributes over the generated lines and admits distinct reversal IDs, so inverse and single-correction guarantees need explicit preconditions or an admission contract.
records.first_formal_obligation: Establish that every reachable ledger preserves debit-credit equality and closed-period entries under posting, closure and reversal, with exact-retry idempotence and an explicit contract for when a reversal cancels the original. Establish separately that statement projections preserve their equations over the admitted account domain.
